items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I joined him at almost end of the second week.

ctx.x: But my wife and I -- in going to join Lionel, I talked to him at Ken Wood's office for 45 minutes from San
Francisco. He was in his first week, and he stayed there two weeks, and I joined him at almost end of the second week.
Well, I take it that Lionel, being in the room (inaudible), heard you.
